title: Procoagulant platelets in HIT
summary: We want to investigate the association of procoagulant platelets and thromboembolic events in patients with suspected heparin-induced thrombocytopenia.

interventions.name: This is a clinical pilot study at the University Hospital Tübingen. Blood samples (2 citrated blood tubes of 5ml each) from patients with suspected acute HIT type II will be collected and analyzed for the prevalence of procoagulant platelets at the Institute of Clinical and Experimental Transfusion

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Inpatients with acute suspicion of HIT type II, minimum age 18 years, consent to participate in the study possible.
Exclusion criteria:
Patients with APS
